description: Header file defining internal media support functions for platform capabilities, including support checks for video and audio codecs, supported video configurations, and external dependencies.

methods.name: SbMediaIsSupported
methods.description: Checks if the platform supports decoding specified video and audio codecs with a given key system.

methods.name: SbMediaIsVideoSupported
methods.description: Checks if a specific video configuration (resolution, bitrate, fps, etc.) is supported on the platform.

methods.name: SbMediaIsAudioSupported
methods.description: Checks if a specific audio codec at a given bitrate is supported on the platform.
